identity_users_subtitle: Every account has the same permissions.
identity_users_delete_body: Their sessions are closed and their pending invites deleted. The API tokens they created keep working.
identity_users_reset_body: All their sessions are closed. When they sign in again with their password, they can set up a new 2FA (and must, if the panel requires it).
identity_error_cannot_delete_self: You can't delete your own user.
identity_invite_body: Send this link to the person you want to add. It works only once.
identity_invite_once: It won't be shown again: muelle only keeps its hash.
identity_tokens_subtitle: For GitHub Actions. A token can only read its project or stage, change variables, deploy and roll back.
identity_tokens_revoke_body: Anything using this token gets a 401 from now on. This can't be undone.
identity_tokens_empty_body: Create one so GitHub Actions can deploy without your session.
identity_tokens_created_body: Copy it now. Save it in GitHub as the secret
identity_tokens_once: It won't be shown again: muelle only keeps its hash.
identity_token_form_description: Choose what it can see and whether it can change anything. Any other operation returns 403.
identity_token_form_all_projects_hint: An all-projects token is always read-only. It expires in 90 days: you can change the date or clear it.
identity_token_form_expires_hint: Without a date, it never expires.
identity_token_form_read_only_hint: Reads status, deploys, logs, variables (without secrets) and domains. Can't deploy or change variables. Recommended for Claude Code.
identity_token_form_no_projects: There are no projects yet: create one to give it a token.
identity_token_form_stages_error: This project's stages couldn't be loaded.
identity_error_token_expiry_past: Pick a date from tomorrow on.
identity_error_scope_not_found: That project or stage no longer exists.
